title: Mandate screen: who clears a top-25 or top-50 cutoff
subtitle: 100 ranked builders. 19 flagged to watch: near a cutoff (ranks 23-28 or 48-53) or changed hands since the list. 7 changed hands since the list was published; 6 now sit under another ranked builder.
method: Inputs: the published 2026 Builder 100 (ranked by 2025 closings, published May 2026) for rank, tier and closings; each builder's recorded owner or parent; and deals since the list from the industry M&A list and the builders' own M&A records. Rule: rank and tier are shown exactly as published and are not recomputed. "Parent that is a ranked builder" is filled when the builder was bought by a ranked builder after the list (the acquirer on that deal), or when its recorded parent name matches another ranked builder; parents that are not homebuilders on the list (for example Berkshire Hathaway, Sumitomo Forestry, Daiwa House) are shown in the owner column only. "Watch" is raised for ranks 23 to 28 and 48 to 53 (within 3 places of the top-25 or top-50 line) and for any builder bought, or agreed to be sold, after the list; only whole-company deals count (Berkshire's minority stake in Lennar is left out). The source column is the deal's own source. What is missing: Domain's mandate wording (which list, brand or parent level, tested when) is not public, so this table does not decide eligibility; no pro forma league table is computed; builders ranked 101 and below are not in the data, so it cannot show who would move into a place a merger opens. Run 2026-11-19.
